inputs.prompt: a swan taking off from still water, slow motion, cinematic

_readme.what: MiniMax H3 text-to-video, ComfyUI API format. PROVEN: rendered h3_smoke_00001_.mp4 (640x384, 39 frames, 1.625s, h264) on an RTX 5090 in ~59s.
_readme.why_text_only_works: MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo declares first_frame/last_frame as OPTIONAL (verified against /object_info). Omitting them IS the text-only path — no keyframe chaining is required, and a review that claimed otherwise was wrong.
_readme.duration_hazard: The API's duration is SECONDS; node 6's matching input is `length`, which is neither seconds nor a 1:1 frame count (length=25 produced 39 frames). Binding them would silently render a 4-frame clip for a '4 second' request. Leave unbound until the length->seconds relationship is measured, then add an explicit converter rather than relying on FIELD_CANDIDATES name-matching.
_readme.audio: minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors is installed and this graph does NOT wire it. Output is video-only. Adding audio requires the audio VAE decode plus a muxing node; SaveAudio* and CreateVideo exist for it.
